introHtml: Hicaliber paper bags combine the durability of kraft paper with eco-friendly materials, making them a smart choice for businesses that want sustainable packaging without sacrificing strength. Whether you need small bags for a bakery or large totes for retail, these bags hold up to heavy items and can be fully customized with your logo. Choose from flat or gusseted styles in various sizes, and add your brand colors for a polished look.
